paras.text: When population is homogenous according to a characteristic e.g. population of first year students is homogenous according to education level, then simple random sampling is good method but when population is heterogeneous with respect to the characteristic in which we are interested e.g. population of students in a postgraduate college is heterogeneous according to the education standard because it contains first year, second year,…, 6th year students. Here simple random sampling does not give satisfactory results and in such situations, stratified random sampling is used to obtain representative sample. According to this method, heterogeneous population is divided in to homogeneous sub-populations, called strata. From each stratum a separate sample is selected by simple random sampling and the overall sample is obtained by combining the samples for all strata. This procedure is known as stratified random sampling and the sample selected by this method is called stratified random sample. For example,

◆ Methods used for selection of a simple random sample

i. Goldfish bowl method

According to this method, serial numbers are allotted from 1 to N to all units of the population. The serial numbers are then written on equal size pieces of paper and are placed in a basket or box or a bowl. After shuffling, a piece of paper is drawn. Its number is noted and is returned to the population in S.W.R case, and then another piece is drawn and so on. The process is continued till the desired number of units is obtained.

ii. Random numbers table method

This method has already been described in unit-3

iii. Computer method

This method is like random number table method. The only difference is that here random numbers are generated by computer packages or calculator.

Example 5.2

Select a simple random sample of size 5, without replacement from the population of 50 employees of a factory by using random number table.

Solution:

Allot two digit serial numbers 00, 01, 02… 49 to employees. Select 5 two digit random number from the random number table, ignoring the two digit number which is greater than 49 or which is appearing again being S.W.O.R case. Let the random numbers be 04, 10, 37, 17, and 48. Thus we will include those employees of the factory in our sample whose serial numbers are 04, 10, 17, 37, and 48.

Note that if we proceed in the same way, we can draw different samples of size 5.

5.1.11 Stratified random sampling

When population is homogenous according to a characteristic e.g. population of first year students is homogenous according to education level, then simple random sampling is good method but when population is heterogeneous with respect to the characteristic in which we are interested e.g. population of students in a postgraduate college is heterogeneous according to the education standard because it contains first year, second year,…, 6th year students. Here simple random sampling does not give satisfactory results and in such situations, stratified random sampling is used to obtain representative sample. According to this method, heterogeneous population is divided in to homogeneous sub-populations, called strata. From each stratum a separate sample is selected by simple random sampling and the overall sample is obtained by combining the samples for all strata. This procedure is known as stratified random sampling and the sample selected by this method is called stratified random sample. For example,

n_1+n_2+\ldots+n_k=n and n is called stratified random sample. It is important to note that stratum should be homogenous with respect to the characteristics under study. However, there should be heterogeneity among strata.

◆ Allocation of sample size to various strata

جب آبادی کسی خاصیت کے لحاظ سے یکساں ہو، مثلاً سالِ اول کے طلبہ کی آبادی تعلیمی سطح کے لحاظ سے یکساں ہے، تو سادہ تصادفی نمونہ گیری اچھا طریقہ ہے، لیکن جب آبادی اس خاصیت کے لحاظ سے غیر یکساں ہو جس میں ہماری دلچسپی ہے، مثلاً پوسٹ گریجویٹ کالج کے طلبہ کی آبادی تعلیمی معیار کے لحاظ سے غیر یکساں ہے کیونکہ اس میں سالِ اول، سالِ دوم،…، چھٹے سال کے طلبہ ہیں، تو یہاں سادہ تصادفی نمونہ گیری تسلی بخش نتائج نہیں دیتی اور ایسی صورتوں میں نمائندہ نمونہ حاصل کرنے کے لیے طبقاتی تصادفی نمونہ گیری استعمال ہوتی ہے۔ اس طریقے کے مطابق غیر یکساں آبادی کو یکساں ذیلی آبادیوں میں تقسیم کیا جاتا ہے جنہیں طبقات کہتے ہیں۔ ہر طبقے سے سادہ تصادفی نمونہ گیری سے الگ نمونہ منتخب کیا جاتا ہے اور تمام طبقات کے نمونوں کو ملا کر مجموعی نمونہ حاصل کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس طریقے کو طبقاتی تصادفی نمونہ گیری اور اس سے منتخب نمونے کو طبقاتی تصادفی نمونہ کہتے ہیں۔ مثلاً،

n_1+n_2+\ldots+n_k=n اور n کو طبقاتی تصادفی نمونہ کہتے ہیں۔ یہ نوٹ کرنا اہم ہے کہ زیرِ مطالعہ خصوصیات کے لحاظ سے طبقہ یکساں ہونا چاہیے۔ تاہم طبقات کے درمیان غیر یکسانیت ہونی چاہیے۔

◆ مختلف طبقات میں نمونے کے سائز کی تقسیم

طبقاتی تصادفی نمونہ گیری میں ایک بڑا مسئلہ یہ ہے کہ ہر طبقے سے کل نمونے کے سائز n کا کتنا حصہ لیا جائے؟ مختلف طبقات میں n کی تقسیم کے لیے عموماً چار طریقے یعنی مساوی تقسیم، متناسب تقسیم، نیمن کی تقسیم اور بہترین تقسیم استعمال کیے جاتے ہیں۔

کله چې نفوس د یوې ځانګړنې له مخې همجنس وي، لکه د لومړي کال د زده کوونکو نفوس د تعلیمي کچې له مخې همجنس دی، نو ساده تصادفي نمونه اخیستنه ښه طریقه ده، خو کله چې نفوس د هغې ځانګړنې له مخې ناهمجنس وي چې موږ پرې علاقه لرو، لکه د پوسټ ګرېجوېټ کالج د زده کوونکو نفوس د تعلیمي معیار له مخې ناهمجنس دی ځکه چې د لومړي، دویم،…، شپږم کال زده کوونکي لري، دلته ساده تصادفي نمونه اخیستنه قناعت بخښونکې پایلې نه ورکوي او په داسې حالتونو کې د استازې نمونې د ترلاسه کولو لپاره طبقه‌بندي تصادفي نمونه اخیستنه کارول کېږي. د دې طریقې له مخې ناهمجنس نفوس په همجنسو فرعي نفوسونو وېشل کېږي چې طبقې بلل کېږي. له هرې طبقې څخه د ساده تصادفي نمونه اخیستنې په واسطه جلا نمونه ټاکل کېږي او د ټولو طبقو د نمونو په یوځای کولو ټوله نمونه ترلاسه کېږي. دې طریقې ته طبقه‌بندي تصادفي نمونه اخیستنه او په دې طریقه ټاکل شوې نمونې ته طبقه‌بندي تصادفي نمونه وایي. د بېلګې په توګه،

n_1+n_2+\ldots+n_k=n او n ته طبقه‌بندي تصادفي نمونه وایي. دا یادونه مهمه ده چې طبقه باید د څېړل کېدونکو ځانګړنو له مخې همجنسه وي. خو د طبقو ترمنځ باید ناهمجنسي وي.

◆ بېلابېلو طبقو ته د نمونې د اندازې وېش

په طبقه‌بندي تصادفي نمونه اخیستنه کې یوه لویه ستونزه دا ده چې له هرې طبقې څخه د نمونې د ټولې اندازې n څومره برخه واخیستل شي؟ بېلابېلو طبقو ته د n د وېش لپاره معمولاً څلور طریقې یعنې مساوي وېش، متناسب وېش، د نیمن وېش او غوره وېش کارول کېږي.

◆ Methods used for selection of a simple random sample

i. Goldfish bowl method

According to this method, serial numbers are allotted from 1 to N to all units of the population. The serial numbers are then written on equal size pieces of paper and are placed in a basket or box or a bowl. After shuffling, a piece of paper is drawn. Its number is noted and is returned to the population in S.W.R case, and then another piece is drawn and so on. The process is continued till the desired number of units is obtained.

ii. Random numbers table method

This method has already been described in unit-3

iii. Computer method

This method is like random number table method. The only difference is that here random numbers are generated by computer packages or calculator.

Example 5.2

Select a simple random sample of size 5, without replacement from the population of 50 employees of a factory by using random number table.

Solution:

Allot two digit serial numbers 00, 01, 02… 49 to employees. Select 5 two digit random number from the random number table, ignoring the two digit number which is greater than 49 or which is appearing again being S.W.O.R case. Let the random numbers be 04, 10, 37, 17, and 48. Thus we will include those employees of the factory in our sample whose serial numbers are 04, 10, 17, 37, and 48.

Note that if we proceed in the same way, we can draw different samples of size 5.

5.1.11 Stratified random sampling

When population is homogenous according to a characteristic e.g. population of first year students is homogenous according to education level, then simple random sampling is good method but when population is heterogeneous with respect to the characteristic in which we are interested e.g. population of students in a postgraduate college is heterogeneous according to the education standard because it contains first year, second year,…, 6th year students. Here simple random sampling does not give satisfactory results and in such situations, stratified random sampling is used to obtain representative sample. According to this method, heterogeneous population is divided in to homogeneous sub-populations, called strata. From each stratum a separate sample is selected by simple random sampling and the overall sample is obtained by combining the samples for all strata. This procedure is known as stratified random sampling and the sample selected by this method is called stratified random sample. For example,

n_1+n_2+\ldots+n_k=n and n is called stratified random sample. It is important to note that stratum should be homogenous with respect to the characteristics under study. However, there should be heterogeneity among strata.

◆ Allocation of sample size to various strata

In stratified random sampling one of the major problem is that how much portion of the total sample size n is taken from each stratum? Four methods namely equal allocation, proportional allocation; Neyman’s allocation and optimum allocation are generally used for allocation of n to various strata. The
